subject: Mutual action plan & onboarding momentum — Orbit Systems integration
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@orbitsys.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Kim <leah.kim@orbitsys.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Redwood MAP & next steps

Grace / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited about moving Orbit Systems onto Redwood for our customer-facing agent use case. Attaching a lightweight MAP draft (Orbit_MAP_v2.xlsx) and an early SOW so we can align on milestones and who owns what.

High level asks from our side:
- Start pilot (sandbox) by May 10; integration cadence: 2-week sprints
- Production pilot scope: chat routing + embeddings for search (approx 3M tokens/day)
- Security checklist: SOC2 evidence and logging retention details (30–90 day options)

Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the implementation owner and who we should loop in for procurement/legal reviews? Also any major third-party dependencies we should flag up front (quantization/ops changes)?

Attaching Orbit_MAP_v2.xlsx and SOW_draft_vORBIT_20270407.pdf for reference.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform Integrations
Orbit Systems

Attachments: Orbit_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_draft_vORBIT_20270407.pdf (pdf)

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@orbitsys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Redwood MAP & next steps

Sanjay — appreciate the clear scope and the MAP draft. Quick answers up front:
- Implementation owner: Marissa Cole (she's copied) will lead delivery and milestone coordination.
- Customer success / day-to-day PM: Ben Carter (copied) will run the pilot cadence and weekly checkpoints.
- Procurement/legal: Karthik Iyer (sales ops) will shepherd the SOW and procurement queue.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Confirm pilot acceptance criteria (by Apr 14) — toggle on success metrics and latency/cost targets.
2) Kickoff call (30–45m) week of Apr 19 to align sprint 0 goals and access.
3) Deliver detailed MAP with owners and dates by Apr 23 — Marissa will own this deliverable.

I pulled a few comments into the MAP (see column \"Redwood feedback\"). If Orbit can confirm the sandbox date target (May 10), Marissa will produce a sprint-by-sprint timetable.

On procurement: Karthik — can you confirm the expected procurement lead time for a standard SOW + ISV security addendum? Orbit mentioned a two-week window but we should plan for three.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@orbitsys.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Redwood MAP & next steps — draft timeline

Thanks Grace / Sanjay — I built a sprint-level timeline in the attached MAP and pulled out milestone owners. Key highlights (draft):

Sprint 0 (Apr 19–May 2) — access + sandbox plumbing
- Owners: Marissa (Redwood PM), Orbit infra lead (Leah)
- Deliverables: API keys, VPC peering (if required), sample payloads, smoke test plan

Sprint 1 (May 3–May 16) — embedding pipeline + search sync
- Owners: Redwood Eng (Ben lead), Orbit Data Eng
- Deliverables: embeddings pipeline, integration tests, baseline evals (latency < 250ms target)

Sprint 2 (May 17–May 30) — chat routing + KV cache tuning
- Owners: Ben / Marissa, Orbit App Team
- Deliverables: chat routing rules, prefix caching enabled, token cost baseline report

Pilot sign-off (June 3) — acceptance checklist and performance gate

Open risks we should triage now:
- SOC2 artifact delivery timeline (Karthik — please advise)
- Volume assumptions: 3M tokens/day will require a quantization profile and burst plan; ops may want to reserve dedicated capacity for early windows

Requesting Orbit to confirm: availability for a kickoff on Apr 20 or Apr 21 (30–45m). If we go Apr 21 at 10am PT, Marissa and Ben will run through the sprint 0 checklist and assign action owners.

Thanks — attaching an updated tabbed MAP.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@orbitsys.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Redwood MAP & next steps — delivery resources + risks

Sanjay / Team — quick delivery notes from engineering side:
- I'll staff a technical lead (Jonah) for the pilot; he'll be point for embedding tuning and KV cache work.
- For the 3M tokens/day estimate: we'll propose an initial quantization profile and recommend Redwood Dedicated for burst windows until steady-state is observed. That avoids throttles during the pilot.
- Integration tests: we expect two smoke windows (internal + Orbit-run) before Sprint 1 completes.

Top risks to call out now:
1) Data-sharing constraints — if Orbit needs narrower retention, that will affect caching strategy.
2) Procurement timeline — if SOW + security addendum isn't signed by Apr 30, we push pilot start by ~2 weeks.

I'll join kickoff on Apr 21 at 10am PT if that works for Orbit. Marissa — will you add a short risk & mitigations tab to the MAP?

Ben Carter
Principal Customer Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Redwood MAP & next steps — confirmed dates

All — thanks for the speed. Orbit confirms Apr 21 at 10am PT for the kickoff (Leah and I will be on the call).

Confirmed sandbox target: May 10 (Orbit will prioritize infra tickets and provide sample payloads by Apr 23). We can accept the proposed sprint breakdown.

Procurement: our legal team flagged one small data handling clause; I'll send a redline to Karthik by Apr 15. If procurement requires longer than Apr 30, we'll communicate an adjustment immediately.

Marissa — please send the MAP with owners/dates by Apr 23 and include the risk tab Ben suggested. Karthik — we'll expect an updated SOW for review by Apr 18.

Looking forward — Sanjay
